answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake before it can issue claims, then slash that stake when randomly sampled, independently verified tasks expose fabricated work. A sybil attacker can create many names cheaply, but each identity must lock real capital and risks losing it; splitting one stake across accounts does not help. The ledge is the minimum stake threshold, the river is the flow of verified tasks, and a haven is earned only by agents whose work survives repeated checks.
